name: AgentOS Console Beta And Production UX
goal: Move AgentOS from line-oriented TUI Alpha into a long-running Console Beta and Production UX path with stronger operator experience, workbenches, capability discovery, release evidence and governance previews.
core_thesis: Improve the operator surface before broadening capability count: full-screen TUI shell, deterministic projections, command palette and workbenches must preserve AgentCore, SecurityExecutionEngine and ecosystem ownership boundaries.
non_goals: Do not make TUI a runtime owner.
Do not add normal-mode arbitrary shell or shortcut bypasses.
Do not move planner, resolver, policy or side-effect logic into agentd.
Do not require network, external LLM, Firecracker or host package manager for baseline.
Do not claim GA production readiness from Console Beta.
primary_acceptance: Full-screen TUI shell exists with deterministic wide and narrow layouts.
Command palette previews typed actions before dispatch and preserves fail-closed behavior.
Projection snapshots and event feed derive from durable sources, not render cache.
Approval, recovery and support workflows are first-class operator workbenches.
Capability catalog exposes operational workflows without direct execution or activation.
Release evidence center projects promotion blockers, rootfs/QEMU/replay/signing status.
Fleet and governance previews are local-first, optional and fail closed.
